epistemic_assessments.rationale: Sequenced from the reconstructions, dispositions and evolution projections in this run; the phase ordering is the pack's default and its preconditions are drawn from the evidence, not asserted.

payload.objective: Generate structured evidence in parallel with the current forums, with no execution dependency.
payload.new_substrate_capability: Precomputed conformance assessment against the four testable architecture standards, produced in parallel with the manual dashboard.
preconditions: The four source systems' coverage of the estate confirmed
A named individual accountable for the precomputed assessment
success_evidence: Precomputed and manual assessments agree across three cycles, with every divergence investigated and explained
No Gate 2 decision changed by the parallel run
payload.stop_condition: Stop if the Authority overturns a precomputed assessment, or if divergence recurs in more than one cycle.
payload.next_phase_gate: Shadow complete after three clean parallel cycles. Nothing consumes the precomputed assessment until then.

required_authority: Each step is a proposal. Entering any phase requires an authorised organisational decision, and this projection neither schedules nor commits anything.
caveat: Phases may be entered per forum rather than across the estate. A design authority at NUDGE and a complaints forum at OBSERVE is a normal plan.
prohibited_inference: That any step is scheduled, approved or committed
That the sequence must be applied estate-wide in lockstep
